Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Fix ad containers collapsing when ads are empty

Problem: Empty ad slots showed large blank boxes with fixed heights
and background colors creating visual clutter.

Solution:
- Removed all fixed heights from .top-ad containers
- Removed fixed background colors (#fff, #17172a)
- Changed overflow from hidden to visible
- Set min-height: 50px instead of fixed heights
- Containers now collapse completely when ads don''t load

Result: No more large empty boxes. Ad space only shows when
ads actually fill, providing a clean UI when ads fail to load.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

EOF

- Correct mobile/tablet behavior
- Clean ad implementation
- No empty boxes when ads don''t load
- Test mode still enabled for development
